item.title: NCDMV ending 7 a.m. openings at 90 driver license offices
item.description: The North Carolina Division of Motor Vehicles says extended early-morning hours at 90 driver license offices across the state will end this week as federal funding runs out.

item.title: NCDOT: Crews make progress clearing snow, but full cleanup expected to take days
item.description: Crews with the North Carolina Department of Transportation are making progress clearing snow and ice from interstates and major highways across the state, but officials say it will take several days to fully clear many other state-maintained roads, especially in areas hit hardest by the storm.

item.title: Local pool tournament sees big draw with thousands on the line
item.description: While most people were focused on the weather over the weekend, there were others who showed up to a massive tournament with the hope of claiming a cash prize.

item.title: NCDOT, New Hanover County officials give update on road clearing efforts, winter storm impact
item.description: The North Carolina Department of Transportation continues to work around the clock to clear roads, though some will take longer to clear than others.

item.title: Wilmington Golf Course turns into snowy playground as kids hit the hills
item.description: Many Wilmington residents headed to the golf course on Monday, not to work on their par, but to enjoy some winter sledding.

item.title: From sleds to snowboards: Cape Fear residents make the most of the snow
item.description: The Cape Fear region is blanketed in snow, and community members took full advantage of the rare snow day.

item.title: Brunswick Co. sheriff takes to snowy streets, aiding drivers and residents
item.description: In Brunswick County, Sheriff Brian Chism has gone beyond the call of duty as a visible figure in the mist of patrolling the roads for collisions and drivers in need.

item.title: Warming Shelter ILM open for 11th of 12 straight nights
item.description: Shelter director Meg McBride said they are at full capacity, with the Salvation Army opening up extra winter bedding and taking in people the shelter has had to turn away.

item.title: 17 former NC State athletes join lawsuit alleging abuse by ex-head trainer, bringing total to 31
item.description: Seventeen additional former N.C. State male athletes have joined a state lawsuit alleging sexual abuse under the guise of treatment and harassment by the Wolfpack’s former director of sports medicine, pushing the total number to 31 in a case that began with a federal lawsuit from a single athlete more than three years ago.

item.title: Trump says he won’t tear down the Kennedy Center arts venue but it needs to be closed for repairs
item.description: President Donald Trump said Monday that he's “not ripping down” the Kennedy Center but insisted the performing arts venue needs to shut down for about two years for construction and other work without patrons coming and going and getting in the way.
